_public_note: Public build manifest. Verbatim retail source strings are stored as SHA-256 digests (fields ending in _sha256); the builder recomputes them from the user's own ROM. Japanese text in this file is written by this project.
_authority: Tracked production authority for the words:name US-only editorial batch. The builder ffta_jp_us_only_words_name.py consumes this file; it is the translation decision of record.
scope: genuine US-only visible entries with no JP original wording (class 5 editorial)

jp_original_authority.reference: JP words:name indices 0..127, already produced into US 0..127 by the CHR_HALF layers
jp_original_authority.style: standard Japanese katakana transliteration; duplicated English spellings are given distinct readings, as the JP original does for Gilbert (ギルバート / ジルベール)

character_table.rule: CHR_HALF token value v is the same charset index the CHR_FULL lane uses; katakana occupy 81..162 and the長音符 ー is 165
character_table.derivation: validated against the 128 JP/US words:name AUTO_MATCH pairs, e.g. US "Arthur" = JP 82,165,101,165 = アーサー

glyph_policy.reason: every katakana slot in 81..165 except 0xA5 is byte-identical between JP and US (84 universal slots); 0xA5 (ー) is the one divergent slot and is handled by the shipped A5 hookless FULL route pointing at slot 0x06D9

entries.terminology_note: Lezaford is a story character, but no JP counterpart exists anywhere in the JP ROM (no AUTO_MATCH occurrence), so this is a new reading.
"Erma" rendered イルマ to keep it distinct from "Elma" (329, エルマ).
"Elaine" rendered エレーヌ to keep it distinct from "Elayne" (330, エレイン).
US repeats "Katie" (also index 353). Differentiated as カティ / ケイティ.
US repeats "Katie" (also index 338). Differentiated as カティ / ケイティ.
US has both "Darcy" (index 120, JP original ダーシー) and "Darcie"; differentiated as ダーシィ so the pool holds no duplicate reading.
US repeats "Luan" (also index 282). Differentiated as ルーアン, following the JP original precedent that renders the duplicated "Gilbert" as ギルバート (55) and ジルベール (99).
